name: Marine (docks, piers, slips, shoreline, marina services)

items.name: Floating dock, commercial marina grade (floats, frame, decking, guide piles)

cost.method: No public $/SF marina bid unit price was found. Derived from FY2026 BIG Tier 2 project totals per linear foot of side-tie dock: Reefpoint Marina $2,612,600 / 1,450 LF = $1,802/LF (e4); Skull Creek $4,336,800 / 2,769 LF = $1,566/LF incl. utilities, fuel dispensers and a gangway (e5). Assuming an 8–10 ft wide main walk, these give ~$155–225/SF all-in; removing ~20–25% for utilities/fuel/gangway leaves ~$120–170/SF for the dock structure. Mid $120 = low end of that band (timber/aluminum framing); high $200 = concrete pontoons / exposed sites; low $60 = light modular or timber floats, above residential installed prices of $15–40/SF (e14, low confidence).

items.notes: Per SF of walking surface. Structure only — add dock-pedestal (power/water), gangway and fire protection separately. Concrete floats for exposed or large-vessel marinas sit at the high end; wave attenuation/breakwaters are not included.

items.name: Fixed pier / dock on piles (timber or concrete deck)

cost.method: Residential pile-supported docks run $20–40/SF installed (e14, low confidence) — the floor for light timber construction. A commercial timber pier with heavier piles, decking and rails is taken at ~2.5–3× residential (mid $110/SF, judgment). High $250 = concrete deck on steel/concrete piles; the Rock Island State Park concrete dock rebuild/extension plus gangway ($3,652,782 for 600 LF of side-tie berthing, ~$6,100/LF, e9) shows remote/heavy-duty concrete work can exceed this — use a site-specific estimate for such cases.

items.notes: Per SF of deck. Includes piles, pile caps, framing, decking. Excludes utilities, lighting, fendering upgrades beyond standard, and shoreline protection.

items.name: Boat slip, floating, all-in (dock share, fingers, pedestal, utilities, gangway share)

cost.method: Per-slip totals from FY2026 BIG Tier 2 funded projects (total cost / slips): Georgetown Landing SC $1,384,365 / 52 = $26,600 (docks + pedestals, plus fuel update and restroom renovation, e2); New Rochelle NY $1,500,000 / 20 = $75,000 (dock reconstruction, gangway, utilities, pumpout, e1); Old Point Comfort VA $3,499,546 for 66 slips + 1,600 ft side-tie (~32 slip-equivalents at 50 ft) ≈ $36,000 incl. fuel/pumpout/restrooms (e3); Ashley Marina SC $2,033,691 / 33 = $61,600 incl. welcome building (e10); Clayton NY $1,894,085 / 24 = $78,900 incl. boater services building (e8). Mid $45,000 = median of the five dock-dominant values excluding the building share (~$36k–62k band); low = Georgetown; high ≈ New Rochelle / Clayton.

items.notes: Typical 30–45 ft transient/recreational slip. BIG projects favor transient boats ≥26 ft; small-boat (≤25 ft) slips in sheltered water run toward the low end, megayacht slips far above the high end. Excludes dredging, breakwaters, bulkheads, upland buildings and parking.

items.name: Gangway, aluminum ADA-compliant (incl. landing float)

cost.method: City of Berkeley memo (e11): ADA gangway/float replacement with temporary repair estimated at $110,000 (2025); South Cove ADA Accessible Gangway Project $380,000 (2020, includes design/permitting). Evidence years differ by 5 years — not escalated here. Mid $150,000 = 2025 replacement figure plus allowance for landing float/abutment on new work; high $400,000 ≈ 2020 full project (long ADA gangway, 80+ ft); low $60,000 = short (30–50 ft) non-ADA gangway (judgment, verify).

items.notes: ADA ramp slope (1:12 at design low water) drives length — large tidal ranges need 80–120 ft gangways and transition plates. Includes abutment/hinge and landing float; excludes pier/bulkhead modifications.

items.name: Dock utility pedestal (shore power 30/50 A + water, lighting), installed

cost.method: No itemized public price found (BIG projects bundle pedestals with docks, e.g., Queen City Marina's 12 new pedestals inside a $1,000,675 bulkhead project, e6). Estimate = pedestal hardware (~$2,500–6,000 for 30/50 A dual-outlet units with GFP, metering) + share of dock feeders, transformers/panels and water lines (~$3,500–9,000 per pedestal). Judgment — verify with marina electrical bids. Note 480 V/100 A+ pedestals for large yachts run well above the high.

items.notes: One pedestal typically serves two slips. Excludes upland service/transformer upgrades for large marinas and NFPA 303 / NEC 555 ground-fault equipment beyond the pedestal.

items.name: Bulkhead / seawall (steel or vinyl sheet pile with cap and tiebacks)

cost.method: Queen City Marina NJ replaced a 500-ft bulkhead (inner and outer portions) with a protection system, 21 berths and 12 pedestals for $1,000,675 = ~$2,000/LF all-in (e6) — taken as near the high end for marina bulkheads. Residential seawalls run $150–800/LF (e14, low confidence). Mid $1,300 = commercial steel/vinyl sheet pile with concrete cap and tiebacks at moderate retained height (judgment between the two anchors); high $2,500 = tall walls/king-pile systems or difficult access.

items.notes: Per LF of wall. Retained height, soil and exposure dominate. Excludes dredging, riprap revetment and environmental mitigation.

items.name: Timber pile, marine treated (12 in, ~40–50 ft), furnished and driven

cost.method: Residential pile replacement runs $300–1,600 per piece (e14, low confidence), which reflects short piles and small barges. A commercial marine pile (CCA 2.5 pcf, 40–50 ft) furnished and driven with barge-mounted equipment is taken at ~2–4× that (mid $3,000, judgment). Mobilization of marine equipment is not included — small pile counts carry a large per-pile mob share.

items.notes: Per pile. Excludes marine mobilization/demobilization (often $25k–100k+), pile wraps and jetting/pre-drilling in hard bottoms.

items.name: Steel pipe pile, coated (12–16 in, ~50–70 ft), furnished and driven

cost.method: No public unit price found. Estimate = steel (~60 ft × ~50–80 lb/ft ≈ 1.5–2.5 tons at ~$1,500–2,500/ton furnished, coated) + driving with barge crane (~$3,000–8,000 per pile) + cutoff/caps. Mid $14,000 by that build-up; low/high span lighter/shorter vs heavier/longer piles. Judgment — verify against local marine contractor pricing.

items.notes: Used for floating-dock guide piles in exposed water, fixed piers and fuel docks. Excludes mobilization and rock socketing.

items.name: Dredging, marina basin / channel (mechanical or hydraulic, incl. upland disposal)

cost.method: No public per-CY figure could be retrieved this session (USACE Navigation Data Center pages returned 403). Estimate reflects small-marina dredging of clean sediment with upland disposal: ~$15/CY for large hydraulic jobs with nearby disposal, ~$35/CY typical small-volume mechanical work, ~$80/CY+ where sediment needs dewatering, testing, or offsite/contaminated disposal. Judgment — weakest item in this file; verify with a dredging contractor and the disposal site.

items.notes: Excludes permitting (USACE Section 10/404, sediment testing) and mobilization, which dominate small jobs. Contaminated sediment can multiply cost several times.

items.name: Boat launch ramp lane (concrete ramp, courtesy dock share, approach)

cost.method: No itemized public cost found this session. Estimate per 15-ft lane: cast-in-place/precast concrete ramp (~15 ft × 80–120 ft at ~$100–150/SF in-water incl. cofferdam/dewatering ≈ $120k–270k) + share of courtesy/boarding float (~$30k–100k) + approach paving. Mid $300,000. Excludes the trailer parking lot (use parking blocks). Judgment — verify against state boating access grant bids.

items.notes: Multi-lane ramps share mobilization and the courtesy dock, so per-lane cost falls with lane count.

items.name: Marina fuel system (USTs/ASTs, piping, dispensers, containment)

cost.method: Naples City Dock replacement of underground storage tanks for diesel and ethanol-free gasoline: total cost $624,580 (e7) — used as the mid (tanks + associated work at an existing fuel dock). Low $250,000 = small single-product AST system; high $1,200,000 = new fuel dock with tanks, double-wall piping, high-speed dispensers and dock structure (judgment).

items.notes: Per marina fuel system. Excludes the dock structure itself where it is part of floating-dock area, and environmental permitting/monitoring.

items.name: Sewage pump-out station (stationary, incl. sewer connection)

cost.method: Clean Vessel Act FY2025 awards: Illinois $75,000 federal for two new pumpout stations with sewer hookups (e12) and Ohio $402,000 federal for up to 10 new pumpout systems plus outreach (e13). CVA federal share is at most 75% (state match minimum 25%, e13 scopeNotes), so total cost per station ≈ federal / 0.75: Illinois ≈ $50,000; Ohio ≤ ~$53,600. Mid $45,000 = rounded below these since Ohio's award also funds outreach; low $20,000 = simple pump-out cart/portable unit; high $75,000 = in-dock vacuum systems with long sewer runs.

items.notes: Per station. In-slip pumpout systems (per-slip vacuum lines) cost more and are priced per slip.

items.name: Boat lift (marina, 10,000–20,000 lb class)

cost.method: Residential boat lifts cost $2,000–20,000, average $8,000 (e14, low confidence). Marina slip lifts sized for 25–35 ft boats (10,000–20,000 lb, electric, often floating or pile-mounted) are placed above the residential average: mid $15,000; high $35,000 for large or floating hydraulic lifts (judgment).

items.notes: Per lift, installed on existing piles/dock. Excludes new piles and electrical service.
